scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr site/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name wquicks-frontend
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name dev-wquicks-frontend
scripts.deploy:uat: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name uat-wquicks-frontend
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name prod-wquicks-frontend
